turns.question: What revenue did customers who signed up in August or September 2024 bring in on 1 October 2026?
turns.answer: Customers who signed up in August or September 2024 brought in 312.00 EUR of revenue on 1 October 2026 (12.00 EUR from August 2024 signups and 300.00 EUR from September 2024 signups). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
